title: Spiderette
autoCompleteNotReady: Available when stock is empty and every card is face up
cannotDealEmptyColExists: Fill every empty column before dealing

tutorial.stockPile: Stock pile (24 cards). Click to deal one card to each column. All columns must have cards.
tutorial.tableau: Klondike-style seven-column staircase. Arrange cards same-suit descending; Ace-to-King sequences are removed.
tutorial.completedSuits: Number of completed suits. Complete all 4 to win.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

landscapeBanner: Rotate to landscape for easier play

frontendHint.completeSuit: A suit sequence is nearly complete — focus on finishing it
frontendHint.buildSameSuit: A same-suit build move is available
frontendHint.revealFaceDown: Move cards to reveal face-down cards underneath
frontendHint.useEmptyColumn: An empty column is available — use it to reorganize
frontendHint.dealFromStock: No obvious moves — try dealing from the stock
